title: nixos/lightdm: fix option type validation
reason: Applicable: real lightdm module + wired test (nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head bbfceed8e contains 'lightdm = runTest ./lightdm.nix;', line 858). Real diff changes background's own mkOption `type` field, from `types.strMatching("^#[0-9]{6}$")` to `types.strMatching("^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$")` (case-insensitive hex color now accepted) -- a genuine type-declaration edit inside the option's own declaration.
targets_toml: single target lightdm, cfg_ident=cfg (local binding `cfg = xcfg.displayManager.lightdm;`, confirmed by reading the module's own let-block), option_prefix=[services,xserver,displayManager,lightdm], watch=[background].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Unchanged both sides, correctly: background is used as a plain value (set via `services.xserver.displayManager.lightdm.background = ...` in config, referenced as a path/string elsewhere), never as a branch/predicate truthiness condition -- there is genuinely no predicate on this option either before or after the PR. The PR's real substance is a regex-pattern (type validation) widening, a type-declaration edit, not a predicate/branch change -- outside this analyzer's predicate-tracing domain by design, not a missed detection.
